playwright.description: Headless browser driver for UI verification. Lets the agent navigate/click/fill/screenshot the running app to verify it works. Only use these tools when verifying UI scenarios. Requires Chromium installed in the runtime (npx playwright install chromium, one-time host setup).

basic-memory.description: Long-term project memory (Second Brain knowledge base). Used by the second-brain-memory skill to recall past decisions/lessons before work and record session-logs to inbox/. Requires: uv/uvx on PATH, and the Second Brain registered as a basic-memory project (its default). If uvx isn't found (ENOENT), replace command with the absolute path from `which uvx`.
